root_cause: Outbound socket call during isolated test environment violating zero egress invariant.
solution: Set FIXTURE_MODE=true or implement mock transport override in service constructor (_is_test_mode).

root_cause: Module exists in apps/ but was not synced to root apps/ or PYTHONPATH.
solution: Sync the service/router from apps to root apps/ using cp, or ensure rootdir pytest config includes both.

root_cause: FastAPI router was created but not registered via app.include_router() in apps/api/main.py.
solution: Import the router in apps/api/main.py and add app.include_router(module.router, prefix='/api/...').

root_cause: Redis live client attempted connection to localhost:6379 during unit tests.
solution: Use InMemoryRedisFallback when _is_test_mode() is True, and ensure is_connected returns True in fallback.

root_cause: VaultClient is_healthy() made a live network call to port 8200 instead of checking cached status.
solution: Return self._is_vault_connected cached boolean rather than calling self._client.is_authenticated().

root_cause: Using legacy Pydantic v1 .dict() method instead of v2 .model_dump().
solution: Replace .dict() with .model_dump() across all domain model calls.

pattern: (TypeError:.*got an unexpected keyword argument|unexpected keyword argument 'task_id')
root_cause: Hermes runner injects context kwargs (task_id, session_id, user_task) into tool handlers, or in-memory module cache holds an old function signature.
solution: 1. Ensure tool handlers in tools/*.py accept *args, **kwargs. 2. tools/registry.py automatically filters unsupported kwargs via inspect.signature. 3. If testing in live session, run via python subshell in .venv.

root_cause: AdversarialReviewEngine review_target() scanned entire core/ folder including 3,200 vendored files in core/hermes_agent without DNK-MRH headers.
solution: 1. review_target() now defaults to scanning only modified git files (git status --porcelain). 2. Excluded vendor directories (hermes_agent, node_modules, .venv).

root_cause: RecursionError during Locust import on Python 3.14 due to gevent/urllib3 monkeypatching
solution: Use conditional import under if 'locust' in sys.argv[0].lower(): or isolate Locust CLI execution from standard test runner.

root_cause: Starlette TestClient is not thread-safe when shared across concurrent threads in ThreadPoolExecutor
solution: Isolate client instances per worker thread using threading.local() or instantiate TestClient per task.

root_cause: uvicorn.Server.run() does not terminate cleanly when executed inside background daemon threads during load tests
solution: Enforce hard timeout (e.g. timeout 45s) or invoke os._exit(0) upon test completion in test runner.

pattern: SecurityMiddleware HTTP 429 Too Many Requests rate limit in tests
root_cause: SecurityMiddleware rate limiter blocks high-throughput load and stress tests with HTTP 429
solution: Set os.environ['TESTING'] = '1' to bypass rate limiting during load tests.

pattern: Unexpected token 'I', "Internal S"... is not valid JSON on Next.js rewrites in D
root_cause: Next.js rewrites were hardcoded to http://localhost:8000. In Docker, localhost refers to the frontend container itself, causing connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:8000 and HTTP 500 HTML response. Calling res.json() threw a SyntaxError.
solution: Set BACKEND_INTERNAL_URL="http://backend:8000" in Dockerfile.frontend and docker-compose.yml, and configure next.config.mjs to use process.env.BACKEND_INTERNAL_URL. In nodeTasksStore.ts, read res.text() on !res.ok before parsing JSON.
